data.one_liner: Standard library extension for date-times, timezones, collections, and monads.
data.what_it_does: Sugar extends Dart's standard library by providing a java.time-inspired date-time and timezone API, monads like Result, and collections manipulation utilities. It includes synchronous platform timezone detection and range/interval types.
use_when: You need robust date-time and timezone handling inspired by java.time
You want synchronous platform timezone detection without asset configuration
You require monads like Result for error handling
avoid_when: You only need basic DateTime operations already built into Dart
You need heavily established alternative utility packages and want to avoid breaking migration changes
strengths: Synchronous platform timezone detection with TZDB identifiers
Low initialization cost and memory footprint through lazy loading
Comprehensive date-time, range, and interval types
weaknesses: Contains breaking changes across major versions
Depends on platform-specific implementations that might need updates
